recentItems.title: Nicole Kidman and Sandra Bullock on Reuniting for 'Practical Magic 2' Nearly 28 Years Later
recentItems.description:
Powerhouse actresses and producers Nicole Kidman and Sandra Bullock believe that our hardest seasons are often where we discover our truest strength. In this deeply moving and funny conversation from Making Space, Nicole and Sandra sit down with Hoda Kotb to pull back the curtain on the lessons they’ve learned from caregiving and raising teenagers with grace. They explore the beauty of evolving past public expectations, redefining family on your own terms, and choosing to lead with love and gratitude. This episode is about resilience, legacy, grace, and finding peace in the circle of life.

recentItems.title: How to Transition Your Garden for a Bountiful Fall
recentItems.description:
From cold-weather crops to end-of-summer herbs, you can keep your garden growing and giving throughout the fall. Dominique Charles, founder of gardening website My Plots and Pans, joins TODAY with tips for planting garlic, kale and carrots in the fall, saving summer plant seeds once the plants fully mature, turning extra garden herbs into compound butter and more.

recentItems.title: Jared Kushner Defends Record Amid New Russia-Ukraine Talks
recentItems.description:
After being stalled for months, President Donald Trump is restarting peace talks with Russia and Ukraine, dispatching his envoys Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner to Kyiv to meet with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Kushner and Witkoff say their goal is to arrange trilateral negotiations “very soon,” with Kushner adding “these things take time.” NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.
